tasks.short: Hire or evaluate staff without a score

steps.what: Open the role and the staff already in post
Evaluate staff in person for the open role
Write the decision to hire, without a score

tasks.design: The open role is shown from {HCM}. The manager evaluates people in person and writes the hiring decision. The record stores that decision and nothing that ranks or scores a person. No one is hired by a rule. Storing this staff decision needs works-council consent where that rule applies.
tasks.previous_blocker: The decision sat in mail after a meeting, with no single place that showed it was the manager's.
tasks.enabler_now: The role record exists, so the meeting starts from the role rather than from a retold brief.
tasks.still_hard: Evaluating a person, and whether to hire, stay with the manager.
tasks.altitude: The manager sees the role before the meeting, and no person is scored.

evidence.claim: A role can be opened, and hiring and evaluation stay with the manager, with no score. The source pack says investment-fund work barely fits the tools it names, and that a draft may comment only on figures that were queried, with a person signing. A listed figure is not an investment decision.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect needs a human review, and that hiring, appraisal, and staff monitoring need consent. This work does not score staff or investors, and it does not send a trade, a filing, or an offering unless the manager does. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a role is open and ends when the manager has written the decision.
The role has role id and duties, written by the manager. The decision text is written by the manager. The system does not propose a person.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing figure, policy line, or name is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether consent for storing the decision is already in place.
research_questions: Which open roles have no decision written?

already_counted.description: The review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: hiring decision the manager wrote for that role

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is opening a role that is already recorded. The evaluation and the decision stay with the manager, and no score is stored.

tasks.short: Monitor regulatory changes and fund compliance

steps.what: Monitor regulatory and tax law changes
Read changes that affect fund compliance
Decide which development opportunities the fund may use

tasks.design: A list of regulatory and tax changes is opened from {GOV_PORTAL} into {DOCS}. The manager reads what affects compliance. Whether the fund can capitalize on a development is the manager's decision, and it does not place a trade. A title is not a rule that has been applied.
tasks.previous_blocker: Changes arrived as unread mail, and a filing rule was missed until a report was questioned.
tasks.enabler_now: The feed lists titles, so the manager reads the ones that name this fund's rules.
tasks.still_hard: What a change requires, and whether to use it, stay with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides the compliance consequence.
tasks.altitude: The manager sees the change list before deciding anything for the fund.

reach.task: Read a change with the manager

evidence.claim: A change list can be opened, and the compliance judgement stays with the manager. The source pack says investment-fund work barely fits the tools it names, and that a draft may comment only on figures that were queried, with a person signing. A listed figure is not an investment decision.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect needs a human review, and that hiring, appraisal, and staff monitoring need consent. This work does not score staff or investors, and it does not send a trade, a filing, or an offering unless the manager does. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when the regulatory feed has a new item and ends when the manager has noted the consequence.
A change row has item id, title, and date, produced by the authority feed. A title with no item id is read and not stored as a rule.

tasks.short: Develop offering documents and marketing materials

steps.what: Open stored facts for the offering documents
Develop offering text from the stored facts

loop.purpose: Draft offering text only from stored facts about the fund.
loop.input: Fund id and the stored fact ids.
loop.output: Draft text citing those facts, or a stop.
loop.check: Every fact in the draft equals a stored fact.
loop.stop: Stop when the text needs a fact that is not stored.
loop.why_not_simpler: Marketing text that adds a claim cannot be released.

steps.what: Direct the offering and the marketing materials
Release the offering documents the manager directed

tasks.design: Fees, risks, and strategy facts are opened from {DOCS}. Offering and marketing text is developed only from those facts. The manager directs the document and anything extra. It is not released until the manager directs it. A claim with no fact is dropped.
tasks.previous_blocker: The offering was edited from last year's file, and a fee could linger after it had changed.
tasks.enabler_now: The facts are stored, so the draft cites the current fee and risk instead of last year's sentence.
tasks.still_hard: What the document should promise, beyond the stored facts, stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager directs the offering before release.

ambition.what: A fund with stored facts gets a draft offering the day a fact changes, and the manager still directs it.

tasks.altitude: The manager sees the fact beside the sentence.

evidence.claim: Offering text cites stored facts, and the manager directs it before release. The source pack says investment-fund work barely fits the tools it names, and that a draft may comment only on figures that were queried, with a person signing. A listed figure is not an investment decision.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect needs a human review, and that hiring, appraisal, and staff monitoring need consent. This work does not score staff or investors, and it does not send a trade, a filing, or an offering unless the manager does. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when an offering or a marketing text is being prepared and ends when the manager has directed it.
A fact has fund id, kind, and value, maintained by the manager from the books and the fee schedule. A missing fact stops the sentence.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing figure, policy line, or name is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Which claims the committee wants that are not yet stored as facts.
research_questions: Which sentences stopped because a fact was missing?

approvals.approved_version: offering the manager directed for that fund

tasks.short: Analyze acquisitions for strategic and regulatory conformance

steps.what: Open strategic goals and regulatory requirements
Mark requirements that have no stored answer
Analyze the acquisition and its conformance

tasks.design: Strategic goals and regulatory requirements the manager stored are opened from {DOCS}. A requirement with no stored answer is marked as a gap. The manager analyzes the acquisition and decides conformance. A gap is not treated as met.
tasks.previous_blocker: The checklist was rebuilt for each acquisition from an old memo.
tasks.enabler_now: The requirements are stored, so a gap is a missing answer rather than a forgotten question.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the acquisition conforms, and what to do about a gap, stay with the manager.

ambition.what: An acquisition shows its unanswered requirements the day it is opened, and the manager still decides.

tasks.altitude: The manager sees the gaps before the analysis.

evidence.claim: Requirements can be listed, and the conformance decision stays with the manager. The source pack says investment-fund work barely fits the tools it names, and that a draft may comment only on figures that were queried, with a person signing. A listed figure is not an investment decision.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect needs a human review, and that hiring, appraisal, and staff monitoring need consent. This work does not score staff or investors, and it does not send a trade, a filing, or an offering unless the manager does. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when an acquisition is being analyzed and ends when the manager has written the conformance view.
A requirement has acquisition id, requirement id, and answer, with the answer written by the manager. An empty answer is a gap.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing figure, policy line, or name is not invented. The manager does that part.
